pull_request.title: Organize build artifacts by upload name

635a8e13839507cb3cbd063e3cee58ce08b95a48.app/builds/artifacts.py:
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID


def save_artifact(root: Path, build_id: UUID, name: str, content: bytes) -> Path:
    safe_name = Path(name).name
    target = root / str(build_id) / safe_name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(content)
    return target

ground_truth.rationale: The upload name is client-controlled and now retains ../ components. A name such as ../../config.json writes outside the build's artifact directory, potentially overwriting files writable by the service.
